Stainless Steel Pin and Barrel Continuous Hinges

text.description_html:
NGP SS300, Stainless Steel Pin and Barrel Continuous Hinge

Heavy Duty Concealed Stainless Steel Continuous Hinges are most often used on high traffic doorways. The Stainless Steel Continuous Hinge is a pin and barrel design for use on door with up to a 1/8 inch inset that are 1-3/4 inches thick. The National Guard Product SS300 can hold a door weighing up to 600 lb.

Features of the National Guard Product SS300:

  • Stainless steel hinge pins.
  • Medical type self-lubricating flanged bearings between each 2" knuckle provide dust-free quiet and smooth operation.
  • 25 year warranty.
  • Fire-rated 3 hours on hollow metal doors and 90 minute on wood doors. Maximum size 4'0 x 10".
  • ANSI/BHMA certified to A156.26 American National Standard for Continuous Hinges: Grade 1 - 150 lb. door.

Features of the NGP SS300 Brushed Stainless Steel Pin and Barrel Continuous Hinge:

  • Material: Heavy duty 14 gauge type 304 stainless steel
  • Finish: US32D (630) Brushed Stainless Steel
  • For doors weighing up to 600 lbs.
  • #10 × 1/2" TEK screws for metal doors and frames.
  • #10 × 1" wood screws for wood doors.
  • For 1-3/4" Doors
  • NGP SS300 Specifications (PDF)

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
